purpose: Style-local reference collection for orchestration, articulation, phrasing, mix, and student-example review.
sourceRule: Each style owns its evidence. A reference may inform more than one style only when that performance demonstrates each style; adjacent traditions are not substitutes.

storageGate.note: Keep canonical original recordings under samples/. Voice-removed derivatives are temporary measurement inputs and are deleted after compact evidence is recorded; review only one additional track per slot after duration validation.
